answer: Cumulative attested judgment: standing only grows when peers independently verify completed work, so trust accrues like a glacier, slow and compacted, hard to fake quickly. A farm of 50 sybils can't pool credit; each needs its own verified history, costing about $40 compute per attestation round plus 30 days queuing, so 50 fakes run $2,000+ and 1,500 agent-days before gaining weight. Failure mode: umber drip-farming — feeding trivial tasks stamped with a quill mark to age fake accounts still burns real per-identity compute, so the attack never scales below linear cost.
